description: A nested parse reads the recognizer's items, not derivations, so maximal does not apply to it: x spans a b c, though its only derivation elides T where y could have been longer (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy maximal
%elidable T
%rule text $a(w) %conditions matches($a, x)
%rule w A B C
%rule x y [T] B C
%rule y A | A B
